body.name: \omega_x(p_x)
body.def: \(\omega_x(p_x)=\sup_{\substack{h:\ |h\|=1,\ \sum_{a\in\mathcal A,\,y\in\{0,1\}}h_{zay}=0\ \forall z,\ h_{zay}=0\ \text{ whenever }p_{xzay}=0}}\max_{s\in\mathcal I_x(p_x)}\|(I-\bar a_{x,s}\bar a_{x,s}^\top)Da_{x,s}(p_x)[h]\|\), where \(\bar a_{x,s}=a_{x,s}/\|a_{x,s}\|\), with the supremum of the empty set defined as \(0\)\)
